TODO_DIR_DEFAULT.description: The commented-out default example path for TODO_DIR.

TODO_DIR.description: The absolute or home-relative path to the todo.txt directory.

TODO_FILENAME.description: The filename for the active tasks.

TODO_ACTIONS_DIR.description: The directory location for custom action scripts.

PRI_A.description: ANSI color variable or code for A priority.

PRI_B.description: ANSI color variable or code for B priority.

PRI_C.description: ANSI color variable or code for C priority.

PRI_D.description: ANSI color variable or code for D priority.

PRI_X.description: ANSI color variable or code for default/uncategorized priority.

COLOR_DONE.description: ANSI color variable or code for done tasks not yet archived.

COLOR_PROJECT.description: ANSI color variable or code for project identifiers.

COLOR_CONTEXT.description: ANSI color variable or code for context identifiers.

TODOTXT_SORT_COMMAND.description: The shell command used to sort the task list.

TODOTXT_FINAL_FILTER.description: The final shell filter applied to the list output before display.
